boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct OSU study settings, including reservable library rooms, a designated silent area, and an Honors College lounge with stated access requirements.

cards.entity_name: The Library Underground Group Study Space
cards.title: Library Underground Group Study Space
cards.subtitle: Lower Level, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Head to the lower level when your group needs a designated group-study setting; use the floor map to orient yourself near Maps & Spatial Data.
cards.short_summary: A named lower-level group-study destination in Edmon Low Library.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries lists The Library Underground Group Study Space on the lower-level floor map.
cards.source_title: Floor Maps & Study Spaces | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current Edmon Low Library hours before visiting; no reservation requirement is stated for this mapped group-study space.

cards.title: Study Bar
cards.subtitle: First Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Use the first-floor map to locate this designated study bar, then settle in near the library’s circulation and information services.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed study bar on Edmon Low Library’s first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The OSU Libraries first-floor map identifies a Study Bar within its study spaces and group study rooms.
cards.source_title: 1st Floor | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current Edmon Low Library hours before visiting; the map does not state a reservation requirement for the Study Bar.

cards.title: Relax and Read
cards.subtitle: First Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Choose this map-listed first-floor reading area for a change of pace, and use the nearby library services when you need research help.
cards.short_summary: A designated first-floor Relax and Read area in Edmon Low Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The OSU Libraries first-floor map lists Relax and Read among its study spaces and group study rooms.
cards.source_title: 1st Floor | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current Edmon Low Library hours before visiting; the map does not state a reservation requirement for this area.

cards.entity_name: Roy & Marian Holleman Foundation Study Room
cards.title: Roy & Marian Holleman Foundation Study Room
cards.subtitle: Room 109F, First Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Reserve this named room online for focused individual work or a collaborative session, then check in at circulation within 15 minutes of your start.
cards.short_summary: A reservable named study room on Edmon Low Library’s first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU’s first-floor map lists Room 109F as the Roy & Marian Holleman Foundation Study Room; library study rooms are reservable.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserve online or through Circulation & Information; up to two reservations may be active, and check-in is due within 15 minutes.

cards.title: Maribeth Subramaniam Study Room
cards.subtitle: Room 109G, First Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Book this named first-floor room when a contained work session suits your task; return its key promptly to circulation when you finish.
cards.short_summary: A reservable study room named for Maribeth Subramaniam.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU’s first-floor map lists Room 109G as the Maribeth Subramaniam Study Room, and the library identifies it as a featured study room.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserve online or through Circulation & Information; keep conversation inside the room, lock it, and return the key after use.

cards.entity_name: H. Louise & H.E. “Ed” Cobb Study Room
cards.title: H. Louise & H.E. “Ed” Cobb Study Room
cards.subtitle: Room 202, Second Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Reserve Room 202 for an individual or collaborative work block; plan your arrival so you can check in at the circulation desk on time.
cards.short_summary: A named second-floor reservable study room.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries lists Room 202, the H. Louise & H.E. “Ed” Cobb Study Room, on the second-floor map.
cards.source_title: 2nd Floor | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Library study rooms are reservable online or via Circulation & Information; reservations can be made up to three weeks ahead.

cards.title: Jessie Thatcher Bost Study Room
cards.subtitle: Room 227, Second Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Use the second-floor map to find Room 227, then reserve ahead for a quiet study-room session and arrive before the reservation hold expires.
cards.short_summary: A named second-floor study room honoring Jessie Thatcher Bost.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries lists Room 227 as the Jessie Thatcher Bost Study Room on its second-floor map.
cards.source_title: 2nd Floor | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Library study rooms require reservation; an unchecked reservation may be cancelled 15 minutes after its start time.

cards.entity_name: Dick & Malinda Fisher Student Gathering & Study Space
cards.title: Dick & Malinda Fisher Student Gathering & Study Space
cards.subtitle: Third Floor, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: Use this named third-floor gathering and study space when working alongside others; the floor map also places computers, printers, and books nearby.
cards.short_summary: A named third-floor gathering and study area in Edmon Low Library.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries lists the Dick & Malinda Fisher Student Gathering & Study Space on the third-floor map.
cards.source_title: Floor Maps & Study Spaces | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current Edmon Low Library hours before visiting; the map does not state a reservation requirement for this space.

cards.title: Silent Study Area
cards.subtitle: Fourth Floor South, Edmon Low Library
cards.notes: For a quieter reading or writing block, go to the south side of the fourth floor and follow library expectations for a silent study area.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent study area on Edmon Low Library’s fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU Libraries identifies the Silent Study Area as a popular location on the fourth floor south of Edmon Low Library.
cards.source_title: Photo & Video Policy | Edmon Low Library & Branch Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current Edmon Low Library hours before visiting; the official floor map labels the fourth floor a Silent Zone.

cards.title: Honors Lounge and Study Space
cards.subtitle: Basement, Old Central
cards.notes: Active Honors College students can use the basement lounge and computer lab; request the coded key fob if you need access beyond posted hours.
cards.short_summary: An Honors College lounge with workstations, Wi-Fi, and stated after-hours access.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU states that active Honors College students have access to the Old Central basement lounge and computer lab, which has twelve workstations.
cards.source_title: Lounge and Activity Room | Oklahoma State University
cards.access_notes: Restricted to active Honors College students; standard lounge and lab hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; a coded key fob can provide 24-hour access.
